posts.title: See what your AI coding agent is doing with Datadog Lapdog
posts.description: Datadog Lapdog is a free tool that gives you real-time visibility into what your AI coding agents are doing. Here's how to install it, pair it with Claude Code, and drill into a real session to see prompts, tool calls, token costs, and which model handled each step.
